BL-1782 — A role that checks or classifies something by hand, with no script to decide it, records one row in a new verification-debt ledger (backlog/verification-debt-ledger.yaml, keyed by category and ticket, committed on main by the recorder itself). A reader counts each category's outstanding rows against a conf threshold (default 3) and reports a category at or over it with no open ticket declaring `verification_category:` as unowned. The ledger lands seeded with the four land path-ownership hand checks of 2026-09-26 (BL-1711, BL-1748, BL-1764, BL-1768)
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: FIRM (from the intake): a register in the standing-reds / hardening-debt-ledger idiom, with keyed rows, a mechanical count and discharge tracking, not a new LLM judgement layer and not a prompt rule as the only enforcement.
